_note: Canonical source of truth for the status set literals shared by Python and TS. Python (flow_sdk/builtin/worker_status.py + flow_sdk/builtin/agentic_process/status_predicates.py + flow_sdk/builtin/process_lifecycle.py) and TS (ts_sdk/src/process/agentic-types.ts) must equal these byte-for-byte. Contract tests on both sides load this file and assert set equality; editing one side without the other breaks both.
_note_process_running_wire: Since busy/ready are no longer projected into status, the wire live-set equals the stored live-set: `running` is emitted verbatim and turn-in-flight is the separate `busy` boolean.
_note_ready_for_input: Cross-language truth table for the ready-for-input projection: Python is_ready_from_busy(status, busy, pty_mode=..., session_id=...) and TS isReadyForInput({status, busy, pty_mode, session_id}) must both produce `expected` for every row. Covers the RUNNING baseline, the fresh-headless branch (NEW + CLI transport), and the headless-idle branch (STOPPED + CLI transport + session).

ready_for_input_cases.label: RUNNING PTY, no turn in flight -> ready
fresh headless NEW but busy -> not ready
headless STOPPED, never prompted -> not ready
headless-idle signature but busy -> not ready

_note_transport_switch: Cross-language truth table for the chat/vibe<->terminal transport switch gate (FLOWPAD-2105). TS surfaceTransportGate(process, viewMode) (ui/src/components/terminal/interactive-terminal/use-process-surface.ts) must produce {needs_switch, route, blocked} for every row; it is read by BOTH the reconcile effect and the footer ViewToggle's greyed-out state, so the control can never offer a switch the effect would refuse - nor refuse one the server would have honoured. The client mirrors the SERVER PER ROUTE and invents no policy of its own: blocked == backend_refuses on every row. The asymmetry is real - only ->cli goes through the guarded switch-mode action; ->terminal routes through start()/open, which has NO mid-turn guard, so a mid-turn ->terminal is accepted by both sides. If a guard is ever added to open, flip backend_refuses AND blocked on those rows together.

transport_switch_cases.label: headless + chat: transport already matches -> no call, never gated
headless MID-TURN + vibe: chat<->vibe moves no worker -> never gated
PTY MID-TURN + terminal: already on the PTY -> never gated
PTY MID-TURN + dev: dev is a terminal surface too -> never gated
->terminal at idle: spawn the PTY via switch-mode {interactive}
->terminal MID-TURN: switch-mode 409s in BOTH directions, so the client refuses too - one route, one guard, no asymmetry left to mirror
->terminal on a FAILED session: not busy -> allowed; the interactive branch carries retry=True, which is how it is revived
->terminal on a fresh headless NEW process: not busy -> allowed
->chat at idle: switch-mode {cli} kills the PTY and clears pty_mode
->chat MID-TURN: client refuses, and switch-mode would 409
->vibe MID-TURN: same refusal on the vibe surface
->chat on a PTY the user ended with /exit (STOPPED): neither busy nor ready, and the session that most needs the switch
->vibe on a FAILED PTY: not busy -> allowed, so pty_mode cannot latch on a dead session
